bagPolicy.summary: The O2 Arena in Prague prohibits bringing excess luggage larger than 40 x 30 x 20 cm. Certain items like laptops and tablets are allowed only for VIP guests.
prohibited: food and beverages (except for health reasons)
spray paints or deodorants – over 100 ml
excess luggage (bigger than 40 x 30 x 20 cm)
unworn clothing (excluding items purchased from official merchandising)
laptops and tablets (except for VIP guests)
umbrellas (except in the case of rain)
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions for health reasons are allowed for food and beverages.

parking.note: Parking is available at the dedicated parking garage accessible via Českomoravská Street and Lisabonská Street. Alternative parking options include the nearby STAGES HOTEL Prague and Galerie Harfa shopping center.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by O2 Arena. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The O2 Arena offers a variety of food options, including fast food refreshments and exclusive catering for VIP areas. The Lokomotivka restaurant provides a unique dining experience with a bar accessible during certain events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The barrier-free entrance is the North entrance on the 1st floor, reachable from Ocelářská Street, Českomoravská metro station, and the Sokolovská tram stop. The arena has 48 spaces for wheelchair users and their escorts. Order wheelchair tickets by email at rezervace@ticketportal.cz.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed unless the event organizer decides otherwise. A ticket is good for one entry and becomes invalid once you leave the arena.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Ticketportal box office is at entrance no. 10. It is open Monday to Friday from 1:00 PM to 6:00 PM, and on event days from 1:00 PM until 30 minutes after the event starts. On weekends it opens only on event days, and the opening time can shift with the event schedule.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: If you come by metro, get off at Českomoravská station (line B). The arena entrance is just a few meters from the station exit; turn right toward the bus station and Ocelářská street.
